children: Aave has launched its official MCP server, giving AI tools and agents a standardized way to read protocol data, manage positions, and prepare unsigned transactions across every Aave deployment. The release covers both V3 and V4 and is the first MCP support for V4.

Because the server prepares unsigned transactions rather than executing them, users keep final approval over any action an agent drafts. AI assistants can monitor health factors, rebalance collateral, or open and close positions while the signing step stays with the account holder. Coverage across all deployments means one interface can operate on multiple networks.
The practical effect is a new agent-driven usage channel that could lift protocol activity over time, though adoption depends on how many tools and users integrate the server.
AI tools and agents can now interact with Aave through the official Aave MCP server.
Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible tool to build agents that can read protocol data, manage positions, and prepare transactions across every Aave deployment.

title: Aave: Official MCP Server Goes Live for AI Agents Across V3 and V4 - 09 Sep 2026
